name: legalease-ai
description: GenAI-powered legal document understanding, grounded Q&A, and comparison application

scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:backend && npm run typecheck:frontend
scripts.verify: node scripts/verify.js && npm run typecheck && npm run build
scripts.scan-secrets: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const content=fs.readFileSync('.gitignore','utf8'); if(!content.includes('.env')) { console.error('SECURITY FAILURE: .env missing from .gitignore!'); process.exit(1); } console.log('✅ Secret baseline scan passed: .env correctly ignored.');"
